test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2023: Official Paper (Held On: 07 Aug, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 1.
solution:
The correct answer is **"nothing."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**
__
 
• The blank requires a negative word to indicate the absence of something.
 
• **'Nothing' **(Option 2) is the appropriate negative word to indicate the absence of an object.
 
• **"Nothing"** means not anything; no thing. (कुछ नहीं; नगण्य, शून्‍यप्राय)
 
 
• **Example**: *I’m bored—there’s **nothing**__ to do here.*
 
 
 
• The correct answer is Option 2.
 
• **Correct passage**:

When Mr. Smith went to a restaurant one day, he left his coat near the door. There was __**nothing**__ in the pockets when he left it, so.......

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1 (coins): **a piece of money made of metal. (सिक्‍का)
 
• **Option 3 (anything): **one thing (of any kind). (कुछ, कुछ भी)
 
• **Option 4 (something): **a thing that is not known or not named. (अज्ञात या अनाम या नामहीन वस्‍तु)

54:Tbb3,

The correct answer is **"pockets."**
